heading: When witness to be compelled to answer.
text: If any such question relates to a matter relevant to the suit or proceeding, the provisions of section 132 shall apply thereto.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
